text:
Sofia: Quick update — MarinerFreight (logistics routing) just went live via PortBridge marketplace listing and converted their pilot into a 12-month Dedicated subscription. Felt like a smooth co-sell with PortBridge.

Tomas: Great news! ACV $310k, onboarding starts next week. They loved the autoscaling burst for peak loads. Who's taking lead on the co-branded case study and marketplace blurb?

Priya: Marketing will take the case study + 1-pager for the PortBridge marketplace tile. @Sofia can you share the pilot numbers and a short quote from the customer? Also want permission to use logo and a 45s customer video clip.

Sofia: Customer contact is Amir Khan (Lead SRE) — amir.k@marinerfreight.com. Pilot highlights: 2.5x throughput improvement for batched routing requests, average cost-per-infer down ~38%, p99 latency improved from ~220ms to ~80ms at 256 token median. Customer-approved line: "Redwood Dedicated let us meet unpredictable peaks without rebuilding our infra."

Dev: Tech notes from the pilot: deployed on dedicated-eu-2 with quantization profile v3, real-time KV caching for prefixes, and request-level routing to fallback smaller models under high concurrency. Sustained 200 QPS with ~40ms median for 128 tokens in steady burst. Attaching perf graphs to the drive. Also noted tokenization gap vs baseline (about +6% tokens).

Maya (Legal): Need explicit logo + testimonial release. Also PortBridge wants our marketplace terms appended to the co-sell MSA addendum. I'll draft a short release form and loop in PortBridge legal.

Tomas: Can Sales secure a short quote that mentions PortBridge as channel partner? PortBridge wants a co-marketing blurb in the listing.

Priya: Will prepare draft assets: case study (1 page), customer snapshot (for marketplace tile), and a short blog post. Tentative timeline: draft by Thu, legal review Fri, customer sign-off early next week, publish with PortBridge marketplace update two weeks after sign-off.

Sofia: Ops items: 1) Sales to confirm PO and billing cadence (Tomas) 2) Legal release sign-off (Maya) 3) Eng to drop perf graphs + config snippets (Dev) 4) Marketing to own assets and launch timeline (Priya). I'll create the calendar invites.

Dev: Small engineering follow-up: MarinerFreight uses a custom tokenizer and one-off pretokenization step in their stack. We should call out the tokenizer note in the case study so perf/cost numbers are reproducible.

marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing "portbridge-marinerfreight" draft uploaded at 2026-03-23T15:24:12Z — awaiting partner approval.

Tomas: Love this. Huge win for the marketplace channel. We'll announce company-wide once Legal and PortBridge confirm copy. :tada:
